newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH BICS100 BOND INDEX RISES 0.035PTS TO 103.401.
newsitem.headline: CZECH BICS100 BOND INDEX RISES 0.035PTS TO 103.401.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds rose 0.035 points in Tuesday's trading to 103.401 points, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.808 years.
The index can also be found on Reuters page ~.BICS~.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, rose 0.081 points to 101.034, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.002 points to 2.349 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 fell 5.870 points to 1,019.736.
